card.name: "To" in "if a decision is made to"
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "If the decision is made" or "If one elects", just before a verb like prescribe or use. Seen mostly in the opioid-benzodiazepine warning text.

modes.label: Decision to prescribe
modes.description: "to" after "If a/the decision is made" in the benzodiazepine-with-opioid warning, before "prescribe".
modes.example: If the decision is made<< to>> prescribe a benzodiazepine or

modes.label: Elects to use
modes.description: "to" after "If one elects", before a drug name to be used.
modes.example: If one elects<< to>> use isosorbide dinitrate

card.writes: It pushes toward words of obligation or emphasis such as "must", though the other promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the "to" in "if a decision is made to", where a condition is about to be followed by an action.
